title.narrative: Developing UAE´s Air Pollution Health Indicator

description.narrative: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) of the United Arab Emirates (UAE) intends to develop a comprehensive national indicator for air pollution and its impact on public health.The indicator is intended to be usedto effectively measure the relationship between air quality and public health outcomes and allowing for informed policy decisions. The development of the indicator will take into consideration the input from key national stakeholders, including the Ministry of Health and Prevention, Dubai Health Authority and the Abu Dhabi Public Health Authority. This project builds on the previous project led by GGGI to develop UAE's national air quality strategy. The strategy, known as the Air Quality Agenda 2031 aims to enhance air quality to contribute to a safe and healthy environment that improves the quality of life in four areas including outdoor air quality, indoor air quality, ambient odors and ambient noise.
